$ATO · Atmos Energy reports annual results and prepares leadership structure change
 Atmos Energy reported financial results for the fourth quarter of 2026 and announced upcoming changes to its management structure. Chairman of the Board Kim R. Cocklin will retire at the 2027 annual shareholders meeting, after which the roles of chief executive officer and chairman of the board will be combined.
